name: You
text: What? Why are talking like that? Can't I just jump over them?

name: Wise Crow
text: You're going to have to get off the ground

name: You
text: What? Fly? I'm not ready! I can barely get off the ground! There must be another way.

name: Wise Crow
text: There isn't, the hall if full of spikes.

name: You
text: Ok, just tell me what I need to do.

name: Wise Crow
text: You need to press (G) to enter fly mode.

name: Wise Crow
text: When you are in the air use the arrow keys to control your flight

name: Wise Crow
text: The flight can also follow your mouse, if that works for you better.

name: Wise Crow
text: Did you get all of that?
